name: Gavia Course (2026)

origin.basis: Giant Group was founded in 1972 in Taichung, Taiwan (BikeRadar).

manufacturing.basis: Giant does not state where this tire is made.

positioning: Giant's 2026 Gavia Course tubeless road tire with a 240 TPI casing, RR-S compound and Race Shield, sold for speed, control and reliability.
weight_basis: Giant's UK and Australian store weights.

wet_notes.summary: Giant claims the RR-S compound gives excellent all-round grip in wet and dry conditions; no independent wet test found.

availability.note: Sold by Giant's UK store and listed by Giant Australia; Giant's US store returned no page for it on 2026-11-01; mainland China not verified.

price_observations.conditions: Official store price incl. UK VAT on 2026-11-01; one tire; delivery terms at checkout.

caveats: The UK page does not state the construction; Giant Australia labels the size '700 x 28C Tubeless'.
Hookless compatibility and maximum pressure are not stated.
Wet grip is a maker claim; no independent wet test found.
